records.text: United States: 621,111 bankruptcy cases commenced in the 12 months ending September 30, 2026 (1.80 per 1,000 residents), up 11.4% from 557,376 a year earlier. 391,386 were Chapter 7, 219,116 Chapter 13 and 9,986 Chapter 11; 594,057 were nonbusiness and 27,054 business.
